verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a local iOS SSH/Mosh terminal client with no product API of its own, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a category error for this kind of product. Its documented SSH key generation (Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA) is for authenticating to remote servers, not for issuing least-privilege credentials to an agent. Any scoping of those keys would be enforced by the remote host, not by Blink.
